content.content: ``` and `/workspace/src/util/types.ts:1283-1303`: ```ts export interface LabelOption< TNuance extends {positionExtra: unknown} = {positionExtra: never} > extends LabelCommonOption { ... // TODO: TYPE not all label support formatter // formatter?: string | ((params: CallbackDataParams) => string) } ``` `MatrixCellStyleOption` is the base of `MatrixDimensionOption`, `MatrixBodyOption`, `MatrixCornerOption`, `MatrixBaseCellOption`, `MatrixDimensionCellOption` and `MatrixBodyCornerCellOption` (see `MatrixModel.ts:135-155` and `:147-169`), so a single change there covers every place a matrix label can be declared. ### 2.4 Runtime proof of the bug (executed against the current tree) A throwaway jest run (jsdom, `test/ut/jest.config.cjs`) with ```js matrix: { x: { data: ['A', 'B'], label: { formatter: 'Col: {name}' } }, y: { data: ['X', 'Y'], label: { formatter: (p) => '<' + p.name + '>' } } } ``` collected the attached text contents of the matrix view group and produced `["A","B","X","Y"]` — the raw values. The function formatter was **never called**. ### 2.5 The `xyLocator` pair that must be surfaced as `coord` `createMatrixCell` already receives the locator pair and forwards it to the tooltip: `/workspace/src/component/matrix/MatrixView.ts:321-329` ```ts setTooltipConfig({ // At least for text overflow. el: cellRect, componentModel: matrixModel, itemName: text, itemTooltipOption: tooltipOption, formatterParamsExtra: { xyLocator: xyLocator.slice() } }); ``` Measured values (same probe run, `matrix.x.data: ['A','B']`, `matrix.y.data: ['X','Y']`, `matrix.body.data: [{coord: ['A','X'], value: 'v1'}]`): | cell | text | `xyLocator` | |---|---|---| | x header `A` | `A` | `[0, -1]` | | x header `B` | `B` | `[1, -1]` | | y header `X` | `X` | `[-1, 0]` | | y header `Y` | `Y` | `[-1, 1]` | | body cell | `v1` | `[0, 0]` | (negative locators = header/corner area, per the `[body/corner cell locating]` doc block at `MatrixModel.ts:53-107`.) ### 2.6 Available helper `/workspace/src/util/format.ts:155-166` ```ts /** * simple Template formatter */ export function formatTplSimple(tpl: string, param: Dictionary, encode?: boolean) { zrUtil.each(param, function (value, key) { tpl = tpl.replace( '{' + key + '}', encode ? encodeHTML(value) : value ); }); return tpl; } ``` This is exactly the mechanism `CalendarView#_formatterLabel` (`/workspace/src/component/calendar/CalendarView.ts:227-242`) uses for component-level label formatters, so matrix should follow the same convention rather than inventing a `labelFetcher`. `isString` / `isFunction` are exported from `zrender/src/core/util` (`/workspace/node_modules/zrender/src/core/util.ts:503` and `:507`). `MatrixXYLocator` is **already imported** in both files that need it: * `/workspace/src/coord/matrix/MatrixModel.ts:30` — `import { MatrixDim, MatrixXYLocator } from './MatrixDim';` * `/workspace/src/component/matrix/MatrixView.ts:22` — `import { MatrixCellLayoutInfo, MatrixDim, MatrixXYLocator } from '../../coord/matrix/MatrixDim';` `ComponentModel#componentIndex` exists and is already used for matrix in `/workspace/src/util/graphic.ts:675` (`const componentIndex = componentModel.componentIndex;`). --- ## 3. Plan (ordered edits) ### Edit 1 — `/workspace/src/coord/matrix/MatrixModel.ts`: add the label option + formatter params types **Anchor** (verbatim, currently at lines 182-189): ```ts export interface MatrixDimensionModel extends Model { } /** * Two levels of cascade inheritance: * - priority-high: style options defined in `matrix.x/y/coner/body.data[i]` (in cell) * - priority-low: style options defined in `matrix.x/y/coner/body` */ ``` **Replacement**: ```ts export interface MatrixDimensionModel extends Model { } export interface MatrixLabelOption extends LabelOption { formatter?: string | ((params: MatrixLabelFormatterParams) => string); } export interface MatrixLabelFormatterParams { componentType: 'matrix'; componentIndex: number; name: string; value: unknown; coord: MatrixXYLocator[]; $vars: readonly ['name', 'value', 'coord']; } /** * Two levels of cascade inheritance: * - priority-high: style options defined in `matrix.x/y/coner/body.data[i]` (in cell) * - priority-low: style options defined in `matrix.x/y/coner/body` */ ``` Notes: * No new imports needed — `LabelOption` is imported at `MatrixModel.ts:24` and stays in use (`defaultLabelOption: LabelOption` at line 215), `MatrixXYLocator` at line 30 (already used by `MatrixCoordValueOption` at line 132). ### Edit 2 — `/workspace/src/coord/matrix/MatrixModel.ts`: use it for the cell style option **Anchor** (verbatim, currently line 199-200): ```ts label?: LabelOption; itemStyle?: ItemStyleOption; ``` **Replacement**: ```ts label?: MatrixLabelOption; itemStyle?: ItemStyleOption; ``` (There is exactly one `label?: LabelOption;` occurrence in the file, inside `MatrixCellStyleOption`.) ### Edit 3 — `/workspace/src/component/matrix/MatrixView.ts`: imports **Anchor** (verbatim, currently line 34): ```ts import { clone, retrieve2 } from 'zrender/src/core/util'; ``` **Replacement**: ```ts import { clone, retrieve2, isFunction, isString } from 'zrender/src/core/util'; import { formatTplSimple } from '../../util/format'; ``` ### Edit 4 — `/workspace/src/component/matrix/MatrixView.ts`: apply the formatter **Anchor** (verbatim, currently lines 284-289; note the blank line before `setLabelStyle`): ```ts if (textValue != null) { const text = textValue + ''; _tmpCellLabelModel.option = cellOption ? cellOption.label : null; _tmpCellLabelModel.parentModel = parentLabelModel; setLabelStyle( ``` **Replacement**: ```ts if (textValue != null) { let text = textValue + ''; _tmpCellLabelModel.option = cellOption ? cellOption.label : null; _tmpCellLabelModel.parentModel = parentLabelModel; const formatter = _tmpCellLabelModel.getShallow('formatter'); if (formatter) { const params = { componentType: 'matrix' as const, componentIndex: matrixModel.componentIndex, name: text, value: textValue as unknown, coord: xyLocator.slice() as MatrixXYLocator[], $vars: ['name', 'value', 'coord'] as const };
